title: Icy Crystal

sources.title: Mourning Frost
markers: | description = {{very rare|Mourning Frost}} is a very rare +1 [[Quarterstaves|Quarterstaff]] that enhances the wielder's {{damage type|Cold}} damaging spells with extra damage and the {{SmCond|Chilled}} condition.

summary: Combine Icy Crystal with the other two pieces to craft Mourning Frost.

fields.Combination: Mourning Frost requires Icy Crystal, Icy Helve and Icy Metal. The result is a +1 quarterstaff with a 1d4 Cold weapon damage rider.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Filro the Forgotten near the Sussur Tree in the Underdark.
fields.Base value: 180 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
